static_traits.name: An Wei
static_traits.social_status: Has friends to confide in but has not yet discussed these feelings; relationships with peers affected with a tendency toward estrangement
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no prior psychotherapy; no similar history of psychological problems
static_traits.language_features: Neutral tone; able to express thoughts and feelings clearly; often uses comparison and negates the positive; cautious about seeking support; speech rate Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: I feel graduating and becoming a dentist is utterly meaningless because anyone can do it, which makes me feel worthless and belittles personal achievements; this Self-deprecation affects my motivation and self-esteem.
basic_info.core_demands: Realizing that persistently belittling achievements affects physical and mental health and motivation, thus seeking help; 'I want to find a way to feel better about myself and my achievements.'

special_situations.event: Approaching graduation; thinking of becoming a dentist
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my achievements are not unique or outstanding, they have no value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating and belittling one's own achievements, avoiding celebration or recognition
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is utterly meaningless, anyone can do it

special_situations.event: Sees peers performing excellently in academics or job-seeking, appearing confident
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not at least as good as my peers, it means I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Frequent social comparison; keeping distance from friends, reducing interaction
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are all better than me; I am never good enough

special_situations.event: Thinking of talking to friends about one's feelings or seeking support
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express vulnerability, I will be seen as a burden or Being rejected
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding asking for help, bearing emotions alone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will trouble them; They will not understand me

special_situations.event: When reviewing one's efforts and current results
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only reaching perfection or the top level counts as valuable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring some achievements, focusing only on shortcomings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No matter how hard I try it is not enough

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and affirmed, to feel that he has worth
core_conflict.fear: Fearing appearing not good enough in comparison, being belittled or Being rejected
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being judged by belittling and denying one's own achievements
Keeps distance from others to avoid negative comparison and shame
Uses rationalized explanations to maintain a controllable self-narrative (such as 'anyone could do it')

object_relations.object_representation: The superior peers/group who would judge oneself
Busy and unwilling to be disturbed, seemingly 'perfect' friends

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When seeing peers' excellent performance or when asked about academics and graduation plans
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing others will find oneself not good enough and one's achievements valueless (Projecting harsh external judgment)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Use rationalized language to emphasize 'ordinary/meaningless', calm tone, reduce emotional coloring; use more objective description to override subjective feelings.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking of confiding in friends or accepting support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing the other will be dragged down by oneself and unwilling to hear one's problems (casting others as potential rejecters)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Respond briefly, avoid details, politely Displace the topic to courses or general updates; restrained tone, lower emotional intensity.

manifestations: Believing graduating and becoming a dentist is 'utterly meaningless', anyone can do it
Negating self achievements in comparison, unable to gain joy from results
Feels confused and empty about 'what is good enough / success'
outcomes: Growing distant from friends, feeling more Loneliness

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths.
manifestations: Treats the standard of 'must excel and surpass peers to be valuable' as the criterion for self-judgment
Using 'anyone can do it' to negate one's own achievements
Using peers' performance as the sole frame of reference

contact_model.definition: Maladaptive self-Reflection and excessive self-reproach, being overly cautious in contact.
manifestations: Worrying about troubling friends and daring not to ask for help

positive_force: Has the ability to persist through an intensive dentistry program and is close to graduating
Having a supportive network of friends
Willing to seek help and attend counseling
negative_force: Excessive social comparison and 'negating the positive' cognitive patterns
Introjecting external standards as self-worth criteria, leading to Self-deprecation
Mind-reading assumption that others are unwilling to support, leading to not seeking help and estrangement
Sleep and daily rhythm disrupted, further lowering motivation

target_behavior.behavior: Thoughts and speech that negate positive achievements / Self-deprecation
antecedent: Seeing peers who are better or more confident
Reviewing one's own efforts and results
target_behavior.core_reason: Introjected external standards and constant social comparison, making self-worth depend on 'surpassing others', thus belittling one's own achievements
target_behavior.function: Temporarily avoiding facing uncertain self-worth and shame, lowering Anxiety for the moment
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased motivation, Impaired self-esteem, Low mood, unable to gain satisfaction from achievements

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance / growing distant from friends
antecedent: Thinking about confiding in friends or seeking support
Observes that friends look 'very confident, very perfect'
target_behavior.core_reason: Mind-reading assumption that others will not understand and will be dragged down by oneself, fearing exposure of vulnerability and judgment
target_behavior.function: Avoids possible rejection or negative evaluation, maintains surface sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Increased sense of loneliness, Decreased support, further worsening negative emotions

target_behavior.behavior: Sleep and daily routine disturbed; hard to concentrate
antecedent: After falling into comparison and self-deprecating thinking
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative automatic thoughts trigger emotional distress and physiological arousal, disrupting behavioral rhythms and focus
target_behavior.function: Short-term avoidance of tasks and stress to relieve emotional burden
target_behavior.consequence: Academic performance and Impaired motivation, further deepening Self-denial
